description: Computes the numbers for a home that isn't saved, from the inputs given, with DoorMeter's ZIP-based rent, tax and insurance estimates for anything left out. Returns the numbers, or what is missing to compute them.

profileId.description: A profile id from list_profiles; the active profile when left out.

rentPerUnit.description: Monthly rent per unit; estimated from the ZIP when left out.

strategy.description: Strategy the numbers are computed in: buy-and-hold, house-hack, brrrr or live-in (living in it).

name: analyze_home
